sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Twelve automated checks in four groups (front door, structure, reading, semantics intact) and two that need a reader. Each check names the activity that fixes a failure.

sections.name: checks
sections.label: The checks
sections.content:
- F1 The identity record is a reading guide (front door). Pass: identity prose ≥ 400 characters. Activity: Write the reading guide into the identity (purpose) record: what this holds, the areas in order, what states mean, where to go next.
- F2 The first document renders on its own (front door). Pass: first composition renders ≥ 500 characters with no parameters. Activity: Install a front-door composition first: the guide, then the top of each area; bind every section to a container.
- S1 A few areas at the top (structure). Pass: 2 to 9 navigation sections. Activity: Group the root into a few purpose-shaped areas, ordered as a newcomer should read them.
- S2 Every root member opens a section (structure). Pass: every root section anchors a container. Activity: Give each root member its own section container, anchored on it.
- S3 Sections are documents, not labels (structure). Pass: ≥ 80% of section anchors carry ≥ 200 characters of prose. Activity: Rewrite each section anchor as an overview: in short, the story, the parts, what is open.
- S4 No level is a wall of items (structure). Pass: no outline parent with more than 15 direct children. Activity: Add a level of parts: group the children under documents that anchor their own sections.
- S5 Everything is reachable from the root (structure). Pass: ≥ 90% of instances reachable through sections. Activity: Place unreached records in the section they belong to, or retire them.
- L1 Fields have human labels (reading). Pass: ≥ 90% of used types' fields have a displayLabel. Activity: Set displayLabel on every field assignment, in the words a reader uses.
- L2 Types have reading views (reading). Pass: ≥ 50% of used types have a view. Activity: Add a reading view per type: title as heading, prose without labels, machine fields hidden.
- L3 Documents use headings and views (reading). Pass: ≥ 50% of composition sections set titleFieldId or a view. Activity: Set titleFieldId and typeDispatch on composition sections.
- M1 The repository validates (semantics intact). Pass: 0 errors (warnings reported). Activity: Fix every validation error; review warnings.
- M2 One record per meaning (semantics intact). Pass: ≤ 2% of records share a type and title with another. Activity: Collapse duplicates into one record; keep provenance as relations.

Needs a reader:
- H1: A person who did not write it reads it front to back and can say what it holds.
- H2: A cold agent, given only the repository, explains it and finds a named record without searching blindly.

sections.name: tool
sections.label: The audit
sections.content: srs-lab readability/audit.mjs (srs-lab#30) runs the twelve checks through the srs CLI, read-only, in seconds on a mid-size repository. How to build a repository that passes is taught at engine.semanticops.com/structure.md (srs-rust#1531).
